meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

copy.tagline: 让智能助手具备部署网站的能力
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望智能助手能自动把网站发布上线
copy.tagline_en: Enable your assistant to deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to deploy websites for you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能替用户把网页应用部署到 Vercel。它会在容器里装好 Vercel 命令行工具，并自动配置登录凭证，之后只要用户发话，就能直接执行部署、查看部署列表等操作。
howto.when: 当用户想让 Claude 把网页应用部署到 Vercel，比如提出“部署到 Vercel”“发到生产环境”等要求时，技能就会接手处理。

say.text: 帮我把这个网站部署到 Vercel 生产环境
say.note: Claude 会用已配置的凭证执行部署命令。

say.text: 列出我最近的 Vercel 部署记录
say.note: Claude 会调用 vercel ls 查看部署列表。

say.text: 检查一下 Vercel 账号是否已登录
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel whoami 验证身份。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can deploy web applications to Vercel for the user. It installs the Vercel CLI in the container, sets up automatic credential injection, and can run deployments, list deployments, and verify auth on request.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when the user asks Claude to deploy a web application to Vercel, such as requesting a production deployment or saying "deploy to Vercel".

say_en.text: Deploy this website to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude runs the deployment using the configured credentials.
Claude calls vercel ls to show the list.

say_en.text: Check if I'm logged in to Vercel.
say_en.note: Claude runs vercel whoami to verify auth.
